newsitem.title: USA: Warm, dry weather continues for Brazil coffee - WSC.
newsitem.headline: Warm, dry weather continues for Brazil coffee - WSC.

text.p: Warm and dry weather is expected to last at least through Thursday in Brazil's coffee belt, Weather Services Corp said in an update on Monday.

According to WSC, mostly fair weather and above normal temperatures should cover the region. The lowest temperatures through Thursday morning will range from the middle 50's to the middle 60's F (12-17 C).

Scattered thundershowers occured in the southern portion of the coffee belt during the weekend. The northern areas continued to see mostly fair weather. Temperatures averaged above normal with lows over the weekend and this morning ranging from 54-64 F (12-18 C).

Increasing clouds are expected for Thursday. Showers should move into the area on Friday and Saturday. "Temperatures may turn cooler Saturday and Sunday although no damaging cold is expected to occur", WSC said.
